court: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
statute_version_applicable: 18 U.S.C. §§2701, 2707, 2510(17) (post-PATRIOT Act 2001 version; civil framework unchanged)
rule_established: Without authorization under §2701 is broad: includes invalid legal process, not just technical intrusion; stored email after reading remains in electronic storage under backup protection prong of §2510(17)(B)
verification_note: Verify 359 F.3d 1066 citation via Westlaw or Lexis before use in filed documents
